description: Define the Todo type and pure functions that read from and write to localStorage. This Feature produces only the data-layer API and does not render anything.
acceptance_criteria: src/data/todo.ts exports the Todo type and the loadTodos and saveTodos functions
loadTodos returns an empty array when localStorage contains no data
loadTodos returns an empty array and calls console.warn when localStorage data is corrupt
saveTodos writes the complete JSON.stringify result to the todomate:todos:v1 key
src/data/todo.test.ts contains three tests covering first load, load after save, and corrupt-data fallback
npm run typecheck and npm test both pass
